content.text:
Hands-on welder and metal fabricator with more than 9 years of experience supporting manufacturing, food-processing,
warehouse, and construction environments in Thailand. Experienced with MIG/MAG, SMAW (stick), basic TIG stainless-
steel work, cutting, grinding, fit-up, jig work, equipment repair, and preventive maintenance. Comfortable reading shop
drawings, taking measurements, preparing material, checking weld appearance and dimensions, and coordinating with
Thai and international supervisors. Strong record of shift attendance and safety compliance. Used to hot-work permits,
confined work areas, production deadlines, and physically demanding jobs. Seeking a stable welding, fabrication,
maintenance, or plant technician position in Thailand or elsewhere in Southeast Asia.

bullets:
Fabricate carbon-steel and stainless-steel frames, machine guards, pipe supports, platforms, access ladders, handrails,
brackets and small process-equipment parts based on drawings and supervisor sketches.

Perform MIG/MAG welding for general fabrication and SMAW for repair and site work; use TIG for selected stainless-
steel thin sections and finishing jobs under senior technician guidance.

Measure, mark, cut, drill, grind and fit components before welding; check squareness, alignment, overall dimensions
and hole positions before sending completed items for installation or painting.

Support installation and repair work at customer factories around Samut Prakan, Chonburi and Rayong, including
shutdown periods requiring night shifts and overtime.

Complete daily hot-work checks, inspect cables and welding leads, keep fire extinguisher/fire blanket nearby, and
coordinate fire-watch requirements when working outside the workshop.

Help train 3 junior helpers on basic welding setup, safe grinding, material handling, tack sequence and workshop
housekeeping.

Reduced rework on repeated machine-guard jobs by using simple jigs and a measurement checklist before final
welding; supervisor reported noticeably fewer fit-up corrections during installation.

Assist maintenance technicians with conveyor frame repairs, broken brackets, damaged guards, trolley repairs and
urgent production-line welding when machines are stopped.

companies: Siam Fresh Foods Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
bullets:
Worked in the engineering maintenance team of a chilled and frozen food factory, supporting daily repairs and planned
maintenance in production, packing, warehouse and utility areas.
SYNTHETIC RESUME FOR SOFTWARE / PARSER TESTING - NOT A REAL PERSON  |  Page 1

Welded stainless and mild-steel guards, carts, racks, drain covers, work tables, pipe brackets and replacement support
frames; carried out grinding and finishing where smooth, clean surfaces were required.

Assisted technicians during conveyor belt replacement, roller replacement, motor changes, pump maintenance, bearing
work and alignment checks; prepared tools and cleaned equipment before restart.

Responded to breakdown calls from production supervisors and helped isolate damaged mechanical parts so repairs
could be completed quickly and safely.

Followed hygiene-zone rules, tool-control procedures, PPE requirements and cleaning instructions for food-production
areas. Learned to avoid leaving metal filings, welding rods or loose hardware in controlled zones.

Kept simple handwritten maintenance notes for completed workshop jobs, materials used and unfinished tasks for the
next shift.

Participated in annual shutdown maintenance and weekend repair work, regularly working 10-12 hour shifts during
major maintenance periods.

locations: Nonthaburi and Bangkok project sites, Thailand
bullets:
Fabricated and installed steel gates, awnings, stair railings, fencing, roof supports, equipment stands and general
structural items for small factories, warehouses, shops and residential projects.

Used SMAW extensively for site welding and MIG in the workshop; prepared joints with grinder, cut steel using chop
saw and oxy-fuel equipment, and corrected fit-up problems on site.

Loaded and unloaded steel sections, moved fabricated parts with team members, set up work areas, and worked from
ladders or temporary platforms following supervisor instructions.

Read basic dimensions from hand drawings and site measurements; checked level and plumb before final welding and
bolting.

Worked with crews of 4-8 people and sometimes stayed at provincial sites for several days until installation was
completed.

Started as a general workshop helper preparing materials, cleaning steel, holding parts for fit-up, moving gas cylinders
with a trolley, sweeping work areas and assisting experienced welders.
Progressed to basic tack welding and SMAW on non-critical frames after in-house practice and supervisor approval.

Learned correct use of tape measure, square, grinder, drill press and common workshop hand tools, plus basic
electrode storage and machine cable checks.
Helped fabricate shelving, carts, sign frames, gates and repair jobs for local customers.

paragraphs:
Completed 2014. Coursework included workshop safety, basic welding, machine tools, technical drawing, measurement,
mechanical maintenance and industrial practice.

MIG/MAG (GMAW), SMAW/arc welding, basic TIG (GTAW), tack welding, fillet and butt
joints, vertical and overhead practice

Steel and stainless fit-up, measuring, marking, cutting, drilling, grinding, bevel preparation,
jigs, brackets, frames, handrails and guards

Minor machine repair, bearing/guard replacement support, conveyors, pumps, motors,
workshop repairs, preventive maintenance assistance

Angle grinder, cut-off saw, magnetic drill, bench drill, hand drill, oxy-fuel cutting, plasma
cutter, measuring tape, vernier caliper, spirit level

PPE, hot-work permit procedures, fire watch, lockout/tagout awareness, housekeeping,
lifting awareness, toolbox talks, 5S

Shift work, overtime, production support, team coordination, job handover, basic work
records, material control

bullets:
Food-factory conveyor upgrade (2024): fabricated stainless support frames and guards, modified brackets during
installation, and supported overnight commissioning work in Chonburi.

Warehouse safety improvement project (2023): produced approximately 40 protective bollards, guard sections and
pedestrian barriers from repeated drawings and site measurements.

Production line relocation (2022): cut and modified existing frames, fabricated new machine bases, and supported
reinstallation during a planned factory shutdown.

Cold-storage maintenance work (2020-2021): repaired racks, carts, protective rails and equipment guards in low-
temperature areas using task-specific PPE and short work rotations.

Commercial steel fabrication (2016-2018): completed gates, roof frames, stairs, handrails and fencing across multiple
Bangkok-area construction and renovation jobs.
